sentences.text: 1 3. Admittedly, the case is of the year 2018.
It is well settled law that the Court shall not issue direction in a mechanical manner to expedite the case as it creates additional work in the court concerned when oldest cases are pending.

The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is accordingly dismissed.
